description.en: Reported revenue for the trailing twelve months ending on the report period date.
description.zh: 采用截至报告期末的最近十二个月已披露营收。

description.en: The model holds disclosed period-end common shares outstanding constant. Additional future dilution may change per-share value.
description.zh: 模型固定采用已披露的期末流通普通股数。未来进一步稀释可能改变每股价值。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios. The July revenue anchor precedes the ACV closing. Scenarios account for the possibility that ACV adds revenue while integration and a wholesale sales mix limit margin. These are analyst estimates.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。 7 月期末的营收基数早于 ACV 交割。情景考虑了 ACV 带来的增量营收，以及整合和批发业务组合对利润率的影响。这些参数为研究估算。

rationale.en: Insurer volumes remain soft and acquisition integration and yard costs weigh on earnings.
rationale.zh: 保险客户委托量仍偏弱，并购整合与场地成本拖累盈利。

rationale.en: International auction activity expands and the acquired wholesale platform adds sales, with lower consolidated margins during integration.
rationale.zh: 国际拍卖业务增长，收购的批发平台增加营收，整合期的合并净利率较低。

rationale.en: Higher auction volumes, better yard utilization and dealer adoption support stronger operating leverage.
rationale.zh: 拍卖量提高、场地利用率改善以及经销商采用率提升，带来较强经营杠杆。
